title: PCrash-Plugin
description:
A PCrash crash-event plugin for the skymine.fun server.

Event mechanic: an admin starts a round → players place bets using custom items → the multiplier grows in real time → each player decides when to cash out, risking losing everything on a crash. Round results are published to Discord via webhook.

Dependencies: CommandAPI (commands with autocomplete), ProtocolLib (custom UI).
